about: Commands Companion runs in a board task's own copy after a run of it finishes, before the work is reviewed. run: the command, run from the top of the repository in the copy. when: paths from there; a check runs only for work that changed something under one of them. timeout: seconds (900 when left out). Work whose checks fail is never approved without you. They mirror .github/workflows/ci.yml, for the parts each change touches.

checks.name: Rust format, lint and tests
checks.run: export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$HOME/.companion/cache/farhelm-target" && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace

checks.name: Web and client tests
checks.run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm -r test
